newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Petroleum signs China contract.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Petroleum signs China contract.

text.p: Imperial Petroleum Recovery Corp president Larry Taylor said on Monday the company signed its first territorial license contract for the province of Hebei, China, including the municipality of Beijing.

This contract provides for $7 million in scheduled payments over the next nine months beginning with the first payment of $3 million to be paid in 90 days, and should produce in excess of $3 million in annual revenues.
According to the terms of the agreement, the licensee will have the exclusive rights for marketing and operating Imperial's crude oil sludge remediation system for the next five years.
